storyCards.fact:
Fastball's "Out Of My Head" reached #20 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #20 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Out Of My Head was released in 1998.

Album: All The Pain Money Can Buy: 25th Anniversary Edition (1998).
